findings.summary: Path resolution utilizes standard Path.resolve() which handles symlink expansion and canonicalization cleanly.
findings.recommendation: In environments where symlinks point to non-existent targets (broken symlinks), ensure resolve(strict=False) default behavior remains safe across Python versions.

findings.summary: Dynamic contract routing provides task-scoped guardrails preventing bootstrap lock while maintaining strict forbidden_paths isolation.
findings.recommendation: In Milestone M-1B, ensure the active task ID is embedded into the Evidence Packet metadata for downstream audit verification.

non_claims: This review does not evaluate physical ASIC RTL functionality or EDA simulation logs.
This review evaluates governance framework conformance and path guardrail robustness only.
Passing 10/10 tests does not substitute for downstream human maintainer sign-off on production release.
